typed-contracts-and-output-validation.guarantees: Strict types, original IDs, complete outcomes and probabilities, negative validation, no repair/truncation

historical-serialization-and-stores.guarantees: Genuine historical producers, immutable manifests and exports, old IDs and one-way compatibility

provider-and-sdk-boundary.guarantees: Pinned actual SDK serialization/parsing, synthetic HTTP transports and byte commitments; no live calls

native-selection-and-transport.guarantees: Authority, endpoint/protocol incompatibility, exact request and immutable selection/attempt identity

durable-submission-and-recovery.guarantees: Every durable failure boundary, independent acceptance, conservative retry, no duplicate sends

cancellation-and-concurrency.guarantees: Owned child exit, cancellation/recovery, lock ownership, bounded independent processes

credentials-privacy-and-security.guarantees: No credential discovery/leakage, full/minimal capture, reasoning authorization, unsafe evidence rejection

diagnostic-evidence.guarantees: Exact retained component, hash-only privacy, immutable read-only diagnostics and failure classification

resource-and-stress.guarantees: Original workload sizes, 90/180-second child deadlines, 32/8/256 MiB limits and growth bounds, process/queue bounds

cross-platform.guarantees: All selected cases exactly once, only documented platform skips, no xfail, all native installation and R gates

strict-r-interoperability.execution: Every one of seven local configurations: 49 strict executions. Hosted Ubuntu 3.11 retains seven required gates. Main pytest retains its actual R checks.
strict-r-interoperability.guarantees: Actual Python-generated outputs and installed CLI consumed in R/jsonlite; missing dependencies fail; IDs/order/probabilities/missing values unchanged

ruff.execution: Every local lane and every hosted job; retained because current cost is negligible

strict-pyright.execution: Every local lane and every hosted job; now checks ci as well as production/tests

packaging-and-installation.execution: Every local lane; hosted wheel on every OS and sdist on Linux as before
packaging-and-installation.guarantees: Build/twine strict metadata, independent core-only install/import/CLI/offline smoke

ci-infrastructure.execution: Full infrastructure suite on hosted Ubuntu 3.11 plus portable infrastructure in each native main suite
ci-infrastructure.guarantees: Source/lock/archive integrity, exact case receipts, missing shard/worker failure propagation, recovery and ownership

hosted-required-jobs.guarantees: Pinned actions/dependencies, same PR head SHA, 50-minute job deadline, failed/missing partitions cannot pass
